title: Pip, the Little Cloud Who Couldn't Rain

characters.name: Pip
characters.look: a tiny round fluffy white cloud with rosy cheeks, big shiny eyes and a small smile

characters.name: Mama Cloud
characters.look: a large soft grey-blue cloud with gentle eyes

setting: a pastel sky above green rolling hills and a small flower garden

scenes.narration: High up in the sky lived a tiny cloud named Pip.
scenes.image_prompt: Pip floating happily in a pastel morning sky above rolling green hills

scenes.narration: All the big clouds could make rain. Pitter, patter, pitter, patter! But Pip could only make one tiny drop.
scenes.image_prompt: big friendly clouds raining gently on fields while Pip squeezes out one tiny raindrop, looking surprised

scenes.narration: Pip felt sad. Am I too small to help anyone, Pip wondered.
scenes.image_prompt: Pip looking a little sad, drifting alone near a crescent moon at dusk, soft purple sky

scenes.narration: Then Pip saw a tiny flower in the garden, drooping and thirsty.
scenes.image_prompt: a tiny droopy pink flower in a garden looking up at Pip floating above it

scenes.narration: Pip took a deep breath and gave one tiny drop. Plip! The little flower lifted its head and smiled.
scenes.image_prompt: one sparkling raindrop falling from Pip onto the tiny pink flower which is now standing tall and smiling, sparkles around

scenes.narration: From that day on, Pip knew. Even the smallest helper can make a big difference.
scenes.image_prompt: Pip and Mama Cloud smiling together above a garden full of happy blooming flowers, rainbow in the background

card.text: Even the smallest helper can make a big difference.
